name: Ferroncite-AD
description: A barium hexaferrite ceramic composite engineered for simultaneous structural and electromagnetic shielding performance, providing ballistic protection comparable to alumina plate armor while absorbing radar and microwave frequencies across a broad spectrum tuned during manufacture. The ferrite grain orientation is controlled through magnetic-field-assisted sintering, allowing the electromagnetic absorption spectrum to be customized to specific threat frequencies — a feature that has made Ferroncite-AD essential for stealth-capable military platforms. Crucible Industries produces the base material, while Tessera Materials handles the spectrum-customization sintering for classified military clients.
applications: stealth aircraft and drone fuselage panels
story_hooks: A panel of Ferroncite-AD with a classified absorption spectrum has surfaced in a Tier 2 salvage market — whoever sold it had access to a military platform, and multiple intelligence agencies are quietly converging on the seller.

A corporate security team has illegally installed Ferroncite-AD panels in a private facility, making it effectively invisible to surveillance drones — the permit violations are the least of the legal problems if this becomes public.

A character discovers that a specific batch of Ferroncite-AD has been tuned to absorb the exact frequency used by emergency rescue beacons — anyone trapped inside a structure lined with it cannot call for help.
